note: PREVIEW thresholds: the same fixed storm / warm-snow trigger values are used for every tile (not the tile's own ERA5 winter percentile, which forecast_core.py's rule is written for). The elevation grid is real, sampled from this portal's own Copernicus GLO-30 DEM. Replace data/tile_thresholds.csv with the analysis team's calibrated per-tile file (same columns) to activate the operational rule -- no code change needed.
